# watchpoint_annotations (Data Source)

Lists chart annotations (deploy and config markers, hand-placed notes) in a time window, oldest first. Without `from` / `to` the window is the last 7 days, so the result moves as time passes; pin the window when the list feeds other resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deploy markers for the checkout service in a pinned window.
data "watchpoint_annotations" "checkout_deploys" {
  from     = "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"
  to       = "2026-10-08T00:00:00Z"
  source   = "deploy"
  ref_kind = "service"
  ref_id   = "checkout"
}

output "checkout_deploy_labels" {
  value = [for a in data.watchpoint_annotations.checkout_deploys.annotations : a.label]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `from` (String) Window start (RFC 3339, UTC). Defaults to 7 days before now.
- `include_unscoped` (Boolean) With `ref_kind` and `ref_id`, also return tenant-wide annotations (what a chart for that resource shows), but never ones scoped to another resource.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum rows returned, `1` to `1000`. Defaults to `500`.
- `ref_id` (String) Only annotations scoped to this monitor id or service name.
- `ref_kind` (String) Only annotations scoped to this kind of resource: `monitor` or `service`.
- `source` (String) Only annotations from this source, for example `manual`, `deploy` or `config`.
- `to` (String) Window end (RFC 3339, UTC). Defaults to now.

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Attributes List) Annotations in the window, oldest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--annotations))

<a id="nestedatt--annotations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `annotations`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) Display color, if set.
- `created_by_name` (String) Name or email of the author, for hand-placed annotations.
- `description` (String) Longer description, if any.
- `duration_ms` (Number) Length of a range annotation in milliseconds; null for a point.
- `id` (String) Annotation ID.
- `label` (String) Short label shown on the chart.
- `occurred_at` (String) When it happened (RFC 3339).
- `ref_id` (String) Scoped monitor id or service name.
- `ref_kind` (String) `monitor` or `service` when scoped; null when tenant-wide.
- `source` (String) Where it came from (`manual`, `deploy`, `config`, ...).
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags on the annotation. Unordered.
